iterations.critique: Nebula cloud structure is right (soft billows, whole-frame, clear morph between t1 and t4) and the palette is violet/purple. Two misses: the grain is far from '少量/subtle' — coarse noise dominates every pixel and competes with the cloud read (Lightness 60 renders much stronger than the intended 6%); and overall luminance is mid-bright in large areas, above background grade for 暗紫色.

Both nudges moved it: cloud masses now read as a proper dark-purple nebula with deep voids (background-grade luminance ok), evolution clear between frames. Remaining miss is degree, not absence: grain is still visible everywhere at normal viewing distance — the request said 少量颗粒感 (subtle, close-inspection level), and at animation speed 20 this amount would shimmer hard on a background layer.

Converged: dark violet nebula billows with deep voids at background luminance, structure clearly morphed between t1 and t4, and the grain is now genuinely subtle — visible on close inspection, invisible at composition distance. Matches 暗紫色星云/缓慢演化/少量颗粒感 on all counts.
